newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Sino Land shrs ease after bond issue plan.
newsitem.headline: Sino Land shrs ease after bond issue plan.

text.p: Shares of Sino Land Co Ltd edged down on dilution fear after the company announced a convertible bond issue, brokers said on Tuesday.
"Fear of dilution upon conversion of the bonds triggered selling," said Anthony Mak, sales director at Vickers Ballas.
Sino Land shares fell HK$0.15 to HK$7.10 in mid-morning on volume of 5.42 million shares.
"We see the deal having a positive impact on the company's longer term business and that is expected to support the price in the medium run," said a sales manager at a local brokerage.

Sino Land proposed a US$130 million issue of bonds due 2002 convertible into the company shares at HK$8.50. It said the funds raised would be used to fund the purchase and development of properties in Hong Kong.
